full_prompt_en: A square surreal seascape painting shows a lone man standing in shallow water before an enormous breaking wave that forms the head of a tiger. The sky is a broad, overcast field of slate gray, with lighter mist spreading from the left toward the explosive water at the right. The tiger's massive head occupies the upper right half, turned in profile toward the small human figure. Its pale muzzle, long white whiskers, dark stripes, half-closed eye, and rounded ear are recognizable, yet the surrounding fur dissolves into spray and foamy water. The striped forehead rises into a crest of white droplets and blue-gray turbulence, as though the animal is part of the sea itself. Near the lower left-center, the man stands still in a dark jacket and trousers with his back to the viewer. His small upright body reaches only a fraction of the height of the tiger-shaped wave, emphasizing the impossible scale difference. A narrow, wet path or shallow reflective water runs beneath his feet toward the foreground. White surf curls along the bottom and right side, while darker blue-gray water gathers in the deep recesses beneath the animal's chin. Fine spray fills the air between the two figures, partially obscuring the lower contours of the wave. The man has no readable facial detail and holds no visible object. Cold, diffuse light comes through the cloudy sky from the upper left, highlighting foam, whiskers, and the pale side of the muzzle, while deep slate shadows define stripes and troughs. The painted surface alternates between smooth, realistic anatomy and countless small, sharp water droplets; foamy edges break into fine stippling. No signs or words appear. The overall composition is vast and confrontational, placing a motionless human silhouette before a stormy, animal-shaped mass in a nearly monochrome blue-gray world.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超现实海景绘画呈现一名独行男子立在浅水中，面对一道形成虎头形状的巨大破浪。天空是宽阔的石板灰阴云色域，较浅的雾气从左侧向右侧爆开的水体蔓延。老虎巨大的头占据右上半幅，以侧面转向微小人物。浅色口鼻、长长白色胡须、深色条纹、半垂眼睛和圆耳清楚可辨，周围毛皮却溶入浪花与泡沫水流。带条纹的额头升成白色水滴与蓝灰色翻涌的波峰，仿佛这只动物本来就是海的一部分。下部偏左中央，男子穿深色外套和长裤，背朝观者静静站立。他小小的直立身体只有虎形巨浪高度的一小部分，强调不可能的尺度差。狭窄的湿路或浅反光水面从他脚下延伸向前景。白色浪沫沿底部与右侧卷动，较深蓝灰色水体聚在动物下巴下的深凹处。细小水雾充满两者之间的空气，部分遮住海浪的下部轮廓。男子没有可读面部细节，也没有持有可见物件。冷调漫射光从左上方的阴云天空穿出，照亮泡沫、胡须和口鼻浅色侧面，深石板色阴影则刻出条纹与波谷。绘画表面在平滑写实的解剖塑形与无数细小锐利水滴之间转换；泡沫边缘散为细密点痕。画中没有标牌或文字。整体构图巨大而充满对峙感，把静止的人类剪影放在风暴般的兽形团块前，置于几乎单色的蓝灰世界中。
style_prompt_en: The surreal painting joins realistic, smoothly modeled forms to a turbulent mass of minute spray, broken foam, and stippled particles. A restricted palette of slate blue, steel gray, pale silver, and near-black keeps the scene cold and unified. Bright turbulent edges emerge from deep gray recesses, so large recognizable volumes seem to dissolve into motion at their margins. A tiny, firm silhouette near the lower edge measures the scale of the immense upper mass. Diffuse overcast light brightens suspended particles and selected pale planes, while shadow pools inside creases and deeper troughs. The foreground is reflective and low in detail; the main kinetic area is dense with fine, sharp marks. Layered mist softens some transitions without erasing the focal structure. The overall effect is monumental and uncanny, using texture contrast and extreme scale to turn natural movement into a dreamlike visual force.
style_prompt_zh: 超现实绘画把平滑塑造的写实形体与由细微水雾、破碎泡沫和点状颗粒构成的翻涌团块结合。石板蓝、钢灰、浅银和近黑色的受限色域使场景冷而统一。明亮翻腾的边缘从深灰凹处浮现，使巨大可辨的体积在边缘仿佛溶入运动。靠近下缘的微小坚实剪影衡量上方庞大团块的尺度。阴天漫射光照亮悬浮颗粒和少数浅色面，阴影则聚在折缝与更深的波谷里。前景带反射而细节较少，主要运动区域却密布细小尖锐痕迹。层叠薄雾柔化部分过渡，同时保留视觉焦点的结构。整体效果宏大而奇异，借肌理对照和极端尺度把自然运动变成梦境般的视觉力量。
theme_en: A lone man facing a giant tiger head forming in a breaking wave
theme_zh: 独行男子面对从破浪中浮现的巨大虎头
name: Joel Rea
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
